verdict.rationale: Anrok's docs and marketing pages claim end-to-end automated filing and remittance ('Filing and payments, done for you', 'Registration handled in every jurisdiction') and expose a filings API endpoint, showing the core filing-remittance automation is delivered. However, no evidence in the pack mentions a specific vendor guarantee covering penalties for late filings, nor independent confirmation of on-time performance. Missing for 10: explicit penalty/late-filing guarantee language, and third-party/hands-on verification of filing accuracy or timeliness.
